#1: Dark Matter

Apple TV has plenty of精彩 sci-fi series for viewers to binge. Besides the hit shows "Severance" and "Pluribus," there's one series deeply loved by fans that you might have missed—"Dark Matter."

This series is adapted from Blake Crouch's bestselling novel, starring Joel Edgerton and Jennifer Connelly.

Season 2 of "Dark Matter" will premiere its first episode on Friday, August 28, with new episodes released weekly until October 30.

#2: Mayday

Apple TV has several new releases this fall, most of which will be streaming exclusives and won't be shown in theaters.

Kicking things off is "Mayday," an action comedy starring Ryan Reynolds and Kenneth Branagh, a fresh reimagining of a classic spy thriller.

"Mayday" will be available exclusively on Apple TV starting Friday, September 4.

Here's Apple synopsis and trailer for the series:

#3: Slow Horses

One of Apple's most acclaimed series, "Slow Horses," is set to return.

In the streaming era, viewers often have to wait several years for a new season of their favourite shows, but "Slow Horses" arrives punctually every year, continuing to deliver the thrilling spy stories led by Gary Oldman as Jackson Lamb.

Season 6 of "Slow Horses" will premiere its first episode on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes released weekly until October 21.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and you can also enjoy discounted pricing through the Apple One bundle.
